prompt:
You are an expert frontend developer and UI designer. Create a single-page, standalone HTML document containing a complex, animated "System Monitor" dashboard with a heavy Cyberpunk / Sci-Fi aesthetic.

STRICT TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:
1. ALL HTML, CSS, and JavaScript must be contained within a single file. Do not import external libraries (no React, no Tailwind, no external CSS). You may use Google Fonts (e.g., 'Share Tech Mono' or 'Orbitron').
2. Do NOT output markdown code blocks (```html). Start exactly with <!DOCTYPE html> and end with </html>.

LAYOUT SPECIFICATIONS:
1. The layout must feature a permanent, fixed sidebar on the left side (approx 250px wide) containing a futuristic user profile and at least four functional-looking navigation buttons.
2. The main content area must utilize a responsive CSS Grid structure to display at least three distinct data panels.

AESTHETIC & GEOMETRIC SPECIFICATIONS:
1. The color palette must be dark mode: deep black backgrounds (#050505), with neon cyan, hot magenta, and toxic green accents.
2. To achieve a seamless Sci-Fi look, the primary data panels must feature an inward-curving top corner (a custom border-radius or clip-path cut-out), giving it a highly structured, non-boxy appearance.
3. Include a subtle, semi-transparent CSS "scanline" overlay across the entire viewport to simulate a CRT monitor.

ANIMATION & INTERACTIVITY SPECIFICATIONS (JavaScript required):
1. Glitch Effect: The main dashboard header text must feature a CSS keyframe animation that occasionally "glitches" (splitting colors or offsetting text for a split second).
2. Live Telemetry: One of the grid panels must contain a "CPU/RAM Load" bar chart or circular progress indicator. Use JavaScript to randomly update these values and animate the bars/circles every 800 milliseconds.
3. Terminal Output: Another panel must act as a terminal window. Use JavaScript to automatically append simulated, matrix-style data logs (e.g., "0x00FF... BYPASSING SECURITY...") that scroll continuously.

Ensure the final output is visually stunning, responsive, and immediately interactive upon loading.
rawOutput:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">
<title>NEXUS//OS — SYSTEM MONITOR</title>
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 40 40'><polygon points='20,2 36,11 36,29 20,38 4,29 4,11' fill='none' stroke='%2300f0ff' stroke-width='3'/></svg>">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Orbitron:wght@500;700;900&family=Share+Tech+Mono&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* ============ CORE / VARIABLES ============ */
:root{
  --bg:#050505;
  --cyan:#00f0ff;
  --mag:#ff2bd6;
  --green:#39ff14;
  --panel:#0a0f13;
  --line:rgba(0,240,255,.15);
  --txt:#9fb6c0;
  --dim:#54707c;
  --faint:#3d4f58;
}
*{ margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; }
html{ scrollbar-color:rgba(0,240,255,.3) #070a0d; }
body{
  background:var(--bg);
  color:var(--txt);
  font-family:'Share Tech Mono', monospace;
  overflow-x:hidden;
  min-height:100vh;
}
::selection{ background:rgba(255,43,214,.35); color:#fff; }
::-webkit-scrollbar{ width:8px; height:8px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{ background:#070a0d; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{ background:rgba(0,240,255,.25); border:2px solid #070a0d; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{ background:rgba(0,240,255,.5); }
button{ font-family:'Share Tech Mono', monospace; cursor:pointer; }

/* ============ AMBIENT BACKGROUND LAYERS ============ */
.bg-grid{
  position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:-2; pointer-events:none;
  background:
    linear-gradient(rgba(0,240,255,.028) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,240,255,.028) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size:44px 44px;
}
.glow{ position:fixed; border-radius:50%; filter:blur(130px); z-index:-1; pointer-events:none; }
.glow-a{ width:540px; height:540px; background:var(--cyan); top:-200px; left:160px; opacity:.12; animation:drift 26s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.glow-b{ width:580px; height:580px; background:var(--mag); bottom:-260px; right:-140px; opacity:.09; animation:drift 32s ease-in-out infinite alternate-reverse; }
@keyframes drift{ to{ transform:translate(60px,40px); } }

/* ============ CRT OVERLAY ============ */
.crt{
  position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:200; pointer-events:none;
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0,0,0,.20) 0px, rgba(0,0,0,.20) 1px, transparent 1px, transparent 3px);
  opacity:.55;
}
.crt::after{
  content:""; position:absolute; inset:0;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center, transparent 55%, rgba(0,0,0,.45) 100%);
}
.crt-band{
  position:fixed; left:0; right:0; height:90px; z-index:201; pointer-events:none; top:-15%;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, rgba(0,240,255,.05), transparent);
  animation:band 7s linear infinite;
}
@keyframes band{ from{ top:-15%; } to{ top:112%; } }

/* ============ SIDEBAR ============ */
.sidebar{
  position:fixed; top:0; left:0; bottom:0; width:250px; z-index:50;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#080b0e,#060809 70%);
  border-right:1px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow:4px 0 34px rgba(0,0,0,.55);
  display:flex; flex-direction:column;
}
.brand{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:11px; padding:18px 16px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); }
.brand svg{ width:34px; height:34px; flex:none; filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(0,240,255,.5)); }
.brand-name{ font-family:'Orbitron'; font-weight:700; font-size:14px; letter-spacing:2px; color:#eaf7ff; }
.brand-name b{ color:var(--cyan); font-weight:700; }
.brand-sub{ font-size:8.5px; letter-spacing:2px; color:var(--faint); margin-top:3px; }

.profile{
  display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:center; padding:16px;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 15% 0%, rgba(0,240,255,.06), transparent 60%);
}
.avatar{ width:52px; height:52px; position:relative; flex:none; }
.avatar::before{
  content:""; position:absolute; inset:-4px; border-radius:50%;
  background:conic-gradient(from 0deg, var(--cyan), transparent 30%, var(--mag) 52%, transparent 78%, var(--cyan));
  animation:spin 7s linear infinite; opacity:.75;
}
.avatar::after{ content:""; position:absolute; inset:-2px; border-radius:50%; background:#07090c; }
.avatar span{
  position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:2; display:grid; place-items:center;
  font-family:'Orbitron'; font-weight:700; font-size:15px; color:var(--cyan);
  text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(0,240,255,.7);
}
.avatar .dot{
  position:absolute; z-index:3; right:-1px; bottom:-1px; width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--green); border:2px solid #07090c; box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--green); animation:pulse 1.6s infinite;
}
@keyframes spin{ to{ transform:rotate(360deg); } }
@keyframes pulse{ 50%{ opacity:.35; } }
.p-name{ font-family:'Orbitron'; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:2px; color:#dff4fc; }
.p-role{ font-size:9px; letter-spacing:2px; color:var(--cyan); margin-top:3px; }
.p-id{ font-size:9px; letter-spacing:1px; color:var(--faint); margin-top:3px; }

.nav{ flex:1; padding:10px 0 14px; overflow-y:auto; }
.nav-label{ font-size:8.5px; letter-spacing:3px; color:var(--faint); padding:8px 18px 12px; }
.nav-btn{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:11px; width:100%;
  padding:12px 16px; background:none; border:none;
  border-left:2px solid transparent;
  color:#7d8f99; font-size:12px; letter-spacing:2px;
  position:relative; transition:all .25s ease; text-align:left;
}
.nav-btn svg{ width:16px; height:16px; flex:none; }
.nav-btn em{ margin-left:auto; font-style:normal; font-size:9px; color:#33454e; letter-spacing:1px; }
.nav-btn .badge{
  margin-left:auto; background:var(--mag); color:#050505; font-size:9px; font-weight:bold;
  padding:1px 6px; letter-spacing:1px; box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(255,43,214,.6);
}
.nav-btn:hover{
  color:#d7f6ff; border-left-color:rgba(0,240,255,.45); transform:translateX(3px);
  background:linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,240,255,.09), transparent 75%);
}
.nav-btn:hover svg{ filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(0,240,255,.8)); }
.nav-btn.active{
  color:var(--cyan); border-left-color:var(--cyan);
  background:linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,240,255,.13), transparent 75%);
  text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(0,240,255,.6);
}
.nav-btn.active em{ color:var(--cyan); }

.side-foot{ border-top:1px solid var(--line); padding:14px 16px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:9px; font-size:9.5px; letter-spacing:1px; }
.sf-row{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; color:var(--dim); }
.sf-row b{ color:#9fd8e8; font-weight:normal; font-family:'Orbitron'; font-size:9px; letter-spacing:1px; }
.pwr-label{ font-size:8px; letter-spacing:2px; color:var(--faint); margin-top:4px; }
.pwr-bar{ height:5px; background:rgba(57,255,20,.1); }
.pwr-bar i{ display:block; height:100%; width:87%; background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--green), #d4ff00); box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(57,255,20,.5); transition:width .7s ease; }

/* ============ MAIN / TOPBAR ============ */
.main{ margin-left:250px; padding:0 20px 26px; min-height:100vh; }
.topbar{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-end; gap:18px; padding:20px 4px 14px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.glitch{
  font-family:'Orbitron'; font-size:clamp(20px, 2.4vw, 30px); font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:5px; color:#eaf7ff; position:relative;
  text-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(0,240,255,.35);
  animation:baseGlitch 4s infinite steps(1);
}
.glitch::before, .glitch::after{
  content:attr(data-text); position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:100%; opacity:0;
}
.glitch::before{ color:var(--cyan); animation:gA 4s infinite steps(1); }
.glitch::after{ color:var(--mag); animation:gB 4s infinite steps(1); }
@keyframes baseGlitch{
  0%,84%,92%,100%{ transform:none; }
  85%{ transform:skewX(6deg) translateX(1px); }
  87%{ transform:skewX(-5deg) translateX(-2px); }
  89%{ transform:skewX(3deg); }
}
@keyframes gA{
  0%,84%,100%{ opacity:0; transform:none; clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0); }
  85%{ opacity:.85; transform:translate(-3px,-2px); clip-path:inset(10% 0 55% 0); }
  87%{ opacity:.85; transform:translate(3px,1px); clip-path:inset(55% 0 8% 0); }
  89%{ opacity:.5; transform:translate(-2px,2px); clip-path:inset(30% 0 35% 0); }
  91%{ opacity:0; }
}
@keyframes gB{
  0%,84%,100%{ opacity:0; transform:none; clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0); }
  85%{ opacity:.8; transform:translate(3px,2px); clip-path:inset(60% 0 5% 0); }
  87%{ opacity:.8; transform:translate(-3px,-1px); clip-path:inset(5% 0 65% 0); }
  89%{ opacity:.5; transform:translate(2px,-2px); clip-path:inset(40% 0 25% 0); }
  91%{ opacity:0; }
}
.tb-sub{ font-size:10px; letter-spacing:3px; color:var(--dim); margin-top:8px; }
.tb-sub span{ color:var(--cyan); }
.tb-right{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-end; gap:9px; }
.clock{ font-family:'Orbitron'; font-size:24px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:3px; color:var(--cyan); text-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(0,240,255,.5); text-align:right; }
.clock-sub{ font-size:9px; letter-spacing:2px; color:var(--dim); text-align:right; }
.status{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:2px;
  color:var(--green); border:1px solid rgba(57,255,20,.3); padding:6px 12px; background:rgba(57,255,20,.05);
  transition:all .3s ease;
}
.status i{ width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--green); box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--green); animation:pulse 1.4s infinite; }
.status.warn{ color:var(--mag); border-color:rgba(255,43,214,.45); background:rgba(255,43,214,.07); }
.status.warn i{ background:var(--mag); box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--mag); }

/* ============ TICKER ============ */
.ticker{
  overflow:hidden; border-top:1px solid var(--line); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  background:rgba(0,240,255,.02);
}
.ticker-track{ display:flex; width:max-content; animation:tickmove 30s linear infinite; }
.t-group{ display:flex; gap:2.4rem; align-items:center; padding:7px 2.4rem 7px 0; white-space:nowrap; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:2px; color:#4f6a75; }
.t-group i{ color:var(--mag); font-style:normal; font-size:8px; }
@keyframes tickmove{ to{ transform:translateX(-50%); } }

/* ============ GRID + PANELS ============ */
.grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr); gap:14px; margin-top:16px; }
.panel{
  position:relative;
  background:linear-gradient(165deg, #0c1116 0%, #070a0e 55%, #06080b 100%);
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.6), inset 0 0 34px rgba(0,240,255,.03);
  transition:border-color .3s ease, box-shadow .3s ease;
  animation:panelIn .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both;
}
.panel:hover{ border-color:rgba(0,240,255,.38); box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.6), 0 0 26px rgba(0,240,255,.07), inset 0 0 34px rgba(0,240,255,.05); }
/* inward-curving top-right corner (concave cut) */
.panel::after{
  content:""; position:absolute; top:0; right:0; width:36px; height:36px; pointer-events:none;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at top right,
    transparent 0 17px,
    rgba(0,240,255,.55) 17px 18px,
    var(--bg) 18px);
}
/* corner bracket detail */
.panel::before{
  content:""; position:absolute; left:0; bottom:0; width:14px; height:14px; pointer-events:none;
  border-left:2px solid rgba(0,240,255,.35); border-bottom:2px solid rgba(0,240,255,.35);
}
@keyframes panelIn{ from{ opacity:0; transform:translateY(12px); } }
.p-tele{ grid-column:span 5; min-height:404px; animation-delay:.05s; }
.p-net{ grid-column:span 4; min-height:404px; animation-delay:.12s; }
.p-sec{ grid-column:span 3; min-height:404px; animation-delay:.19s; }
.p-term{ grid-column:span 7; animation-delay:.26s; }
.p-proc{ grid-column:span 5; animation-delay:.33s; }

.p-head{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
  padding:13px 46px 13px 15px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,240,255,.12);
}
.p-head::before{ content:""; width:3px; height:14px; background:var(--cyan); box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--cyan); flex:none; }
.p-idx{ font-size:9px; color:var(--faint); letter-spacing:1px; }
.p-head h2{ font-family:'Orbitron'; font-size:11px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:3px; color:#cfe9f2; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; }
.p-live{ margin-left:auto; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; font-size:9px; letter-spacing:2px; color:var(--dim); flex:none; }
.p-live i{ width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--green); box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--green); animation:pulse 1.6s infinite; }
.p-live b{ font-family:'Orbitron'; font-size:9px; color:var(--cyan); font-weight:700; }
.p-actions{ margin-left:auto; display:flex; gap:7px; }
.mini-btn{
  background:transparent; border:1px solid rgba(0,240,255,.35); color:var(--cyan);
  font-size:9px; letter-spacing:2px; padding:5px 10px; transition:all .2s ease;
}
.mini-btn:hover{ background:var(--cyan); color:#050505; box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(0,240,255,.5); }
.mini-btn.on{ background:var(--mag); border-color:var(--mag); color:#050505; box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(255,43,214,.5); }

/* ============ P-01 TELEMETRY ============ */
.tele-body{ display:flex; gap:18px; padding:16px 15px 8px; align-items:center; }
.gauge-wrap{ position:relative; width:152px; height:152px; flex:none; }
.gauge{ width:100%; height:100%; }
.g-ticks{ fill:none; stroke:rgba(0,240,255,.22); stroke-width:3; stroke-dasharray:1 5.4; }
.g-bg{ fill:none; stroke:rgba(0,240,255,.1); stroke-width:6; }
.g-bg2{ stroke:rgba(255,43,214,.12); stroke-width:4; }
#gCpu{ fill:none; stroke:var(--cyan); stroke-width:6; stroke-linecap:round; transition:stroke-dashoffset .7s ease; filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(0,240,255,.7)); }
#gRam{ fill:none; stroke:var(--mag); stroke-width:4; stroke-linecap:round; transition:stroke-dashoffset .7s ease; opacity:.9; filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(255,43,214,.6)); }
.gauge-center{ position:absolute; inset:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:3px; }
.gauge-center b{ font-family:'Orbitron'; font-size:30px; font-weight:900; color:var(--cyan); text-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(0,240,255,.65); }
.gauge-center span{ font-size:8px; letter-spacing:3px; color:var(--dim); }
.tele-stats{ flex:1; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:14px; min-width:0; }
.stat label{ font-size:9px; letter-spacing:2px; color:var(--dim); display:flex; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:5px; }
.stat label span{ color:#9fd8e8; font-family:'Orbitron'; font-size:9px; }
.hbar{ height:9px; background:rgba(0,240,255,.07); position:relative; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid rgba(0,240,255,.08); }
.hbar::after{ content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 6px, rgba(5,5,5,.85) 6px 8px); pointer-events:none; }
.hbar i{ position:absolute; left:0; top:0; bottom:0; width:50%; background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--cyan), var(--green)); box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(0,240,255,.4); transition:width .7s ease; }
.hbar.mag i{ background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--mag), #ff7ae5); box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(255,43,214,.4); }
.hbar.heat i{ background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--green), #d4ff00 60%, var(--mag)); }
.cores{ padding:8px 15px 16px; }
.cores-label{ font-size:9px; letter-spacing:2px; color:var(--faint); margin-bottom:8px; }
.core-bars{ display:flex; gap:7px; height:96px; }
.core{ flex:1; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:5px; }
.c-track{ flex:1; position:relative; background:rgba(0,240,255,.05); border:1px solid rgba(0,240,255,.08); overflow:hidden; }
.c-track i{
  position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:0; height:40%;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,240,255,.95), rgba(0,240,255,.2));
  box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(0,240,255,.35);
  transition:height .7s cubic-bezier(.25,.8,.25,1);
}
.c-track i::after{ content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0 5px, rgba(5,5,5,.5) 5px 7px); }
.core span{ font-size:9px; color:var(--dim); text-align:center; font-family:'Orbitron'; }
.core.hot .c-track i{ background:linear-gradient(180deg, var(--mag), rgba(255,43,214,.2)); box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,43,214,.55); }
.core.hot span{ color:var(--mag); }

/* ============ P-02 NETWORK ============ */
.p-net{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
.p-net canvas{ flex:1; min-height:200px; width:100%; display:block; }
.net-legend{ display:flex; gap:20px; padding:11px 15px; font-size:9px; letter-spacing:2px; color:var(--dim); border-top:1px solid rgba(0,240,255,.08); }
.net-legend i{ display:inline-block; width:14px; height:2px; margin-right:7px; vertical-align:middle; }
.net-legend b{ font-family:'Orbitron'; font-size:9px; font-weight:700; margin-left:5px; }
.lg-rx i{ background:var(--cyan); box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--cyan); } .lg-rx b{ color:var(--cyan); }
.lg-tx i{ background:var(--mag); box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--mag); } .lg-tx b{ color:var(--mag); }

/* ============ P-03 SECURITY ============ */
.radar{
  position:relative; width:182px; height:182px; margin:18px auto 14px; border-radius:50%;
  border:1px solid rgba(57,255,20,.32); overflow:hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle, transparent 0 32%, rgba(57,255,20,.15) 32% 33%, transparent 33% 64%, rgba(57,255,20,.15) 64% 65%, transparent 65% 100%),
    radial-gradient(circle, rgba(57,255,20,.07), transparent 75%);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 26px rgba(57,255,20,.14), 0 0 18px rgba(57,255,20,.06);
}
.radar::before{
  content:""; position:absolute; inset:0;
  background:
    linear-gradient(rgba(57,255,20,.18), rgba(57,255,20,.18)) center/100% 1px no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(rgba(57,255,20,.18), rgba(57,255,20,.18)) center/1px 100% no-repeat;
}
.sweep{
  position:absolute; inset:0; border-radius:50%;
  background:conic-gradient(from 0deg, rgba(57,255,20,.45), rgba(57,255,20,.08) 70deg, transparent 130deg);
  animation:spin 3.8s linear infinite;
}
.blip{
  position:absolute; width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--green);
  box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--green); transition:left 1.4s ease, top 1.4s ease;
}
.blip::after{ content:""; position:absolute; inset:-6px; border:1px solid rgba(57,255,20,.55); border-radius:50%; animation:ping 1.8s ease-out infinite; }
@keyframes ping{ from{ transform:scale(.3); opacity:1; } to{ transform:scale(1.7); opacity:0; } }
.threats{ list-style:none; padding:0 15px 16px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; }
.threats li{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 62px 26px; gap:9px; align-items:center; font-size:9.5px; letter-spacing:1px; color:#7d949e; }
.th-bar{ height:4px; background:rgba(57,255,20,.1); position:relative; }
.th-bar i{ position:absolute; left:0; top:0; bottom:0; width:50%; background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--green), #d4ff00); box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(57,255,20,.4); transition:width .7s ease, background .4s ease; }
.threats li b{ font-family:'Orbitron'; font-size:10px; color:var(--green); text-align:right; }
.threats li.high b{ color:var(--mag); }
.threats li.high .th-bar i{ background:linear-gradient(90deg, #d4ff00, var(--mag)); box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(255,43,214,.5); }

/* ============ P-04 TERMINAL ============ */
.term{
  height:302px; overflow-y:auto; padding:13px 15px 18px;
  font-size:12px; line-height:1.65;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,0,0,.4), transparent 40px);
}
.t-line{ white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; animation:lineIn .25s ease both; }
@keyframes lineIn{ from{ opacity:0; transform:translateX(-8px); } }
.t-time{ color:var(--faint); margin-right:9px; }
.t-tag{ display:inline-block; width:40px; margin-right:9px; }
.t-sys{ color:var(--cyan); } .t-net{ color:var(--green); } .t-sec{ color:var(--mag); } .t-mem{ color:#8fb3c9; } .t-io{ color:#8fb3c9; }
.t-msg{ color:#9fb6c0; }
.term::after{ content:"> _"; color:var(--green); animation:blink 1s steps(1) infinite; }
@keyframes blink{ 50%{ opacity:0; } }

/* ============ P-05 PROCESSES ============ */
.p-proc{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
.proc-cols{
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.5fr .55fr .55fr .55fr 1fr; gap:8px;
  padding:11px 15px 7px; font-size:8.5px; letter-spacing:2px; color:var(--faint);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,240,255,.08);
}
.procs{ list-style:none; padding:5px 6px 10px; flex:1; }
.procs li{
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.5fr .55fr .55fr .55fr 1fr; gap:8px; align-items:center;
  padding:8px 9px; font-size:11px; border-left:2px solid transparent;
  transition:background .2s ease, border-color .2s ease;
}
.procs li:hover{ background:rgba(0,240,255,.05); border-left-color:var(--cyan); }
.pn{ color:#cfe3ec; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
.pid{ color:var(--dim); } .pc{ color:var(--cyan); } .pm{ color:#8fd8ff; }
.ps{ font-size:9px; letter-spacing:2px; }
.st-ok{ color:var(--green); } .st-mag{ color:var(--mag); } .st-dim{ color:var(--dim); }
.proc-foot{ display:flex; gap:20px; padding:12px 15px; border-top:1px solid rgba(0,240,255,.08); }
.pf{ flex:1; font-size:8px; letter-spacing:2px; color:var(--faint); }
.pf-bar{ height:4px; background:rgba(0,240,255,.08); margin-top:5px; }
.pf-bar i{ display:block; height:100%; width:50%; background:var(--cyan); opacity:.75; box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(0,240,255,.4); transition:width .7s ease; }
.pf:nth-child(2) .pf-bar i{ background:var(--mag); box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(255,43,214,.4); }
.pf:nth-child(3) .pf-bar i{ background:var(--green); box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(57,255,20,.4); }

/* ============ RESPONSIVE ============ */
@media (max-width:1280px){
  .p-tele,.p-net,.p-sec,.p-term{ grid-column:span 6; }
  .p-proc{ grid-column:span 12; }
}
@media (max-width:1024px){
  .p-sec,.p-term{ grid-column:span 12; }
}
@media (max-width:900px){
  .sidebar{ width:74px; }
  .brand{ justify-content:center; padding:16px 8px; }
  .brand-text, .p-info, .nav-label, .nav-btn span, .nav-btn em, .nav-btn .badge, .side-foot{ display:none; }
  .profile{ justify-content:center; padding:14px 8px; }
  .nav-btn{ justify-content:center; padding:13px 0; }
  .main{ margin-left:74px; }
}
@media (max-width:760px){
  .grid > .panel{ grid-column:span 12 !important; }
  .topbar{ align-items:flex-start; }
  .tb-right{ align-items:flex-start; }
  .clock, .clock-sub{ text-align:left; }
  .tele-body{ flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
  *{ animation-duration:.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count:1 !important; transition-duration:.01ms !important; }
}
</style>
